sampling.rule: Round-robin Nov 4,5,6,9,10,11,12; oldest createdAt then run ID within date; stop >=40 eligible distinct PRs across >=5 dates or 80 attempted merge groups
sampling.recovery: After stopping new samples at 40 eligible v1.1 PRs, recover seven transient transport gaps in already attempted groups: reuse cached responses and make first successful network reads where the prior transport failure produced no cacheable response. Never refetch a cached HTTP response, including the HTTP-502 response. Recovery adds observations, not groups.

current.remainingCriterion: At least 30 eligible identified changes across five working days, individual triage of exclusions and every miss, and reviewed comparison before readiness.

earlier.remainingCriterion: At least 30 eligible identified changes across five working days, individual triage of exclusions and every miss, and reviewed comparison before readiness.
